spec_features.spec_quote: three consecutive prose-only turns ends the run as `stalled_no_tool`
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:99-107: prose-only turns increment `consecutive_no_tool`; `if consecutive_no_tool >= 3: transcript.ended_reason = "stalled_no_tool"; break`. The threshold is compared and breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end: counter incremented, reset on tool use (line 109), compared and breaks.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: counted as a soft form of stalling (useful signal for the judge / analysis)

spec_features.feature_name: persistent provider failure ends run as error
spec_features.spec_quote: persistent failure ends a single run as `ended_reason="error"` rather than crashing the sweep
spec_features.evidence: agent.py: _call_provider retries with backoff then raises RuntimeError; run() except block sets transcript.error and transcript.ended_reason = "error". runner.py run_all wraps run_one in try/except and appends to errors list so the sweep continues.
spec_features.notes: Both the per-run error reason and the sweep-level catch are wired.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: a persistent failure ends the run with ``ended_reason="error"`` rather than crashing the whole sweep

spec_features.evidence: config.py:48 max_turns: int = 36; agent.py:93 `for turn_idx in range(self.config.max_turns)` with for/else at line 142-143 setting ended_reason="max_turns". The budget bounds the loop.
spec_features.notes: Read and enforced as the loop bound; default 36 in config and types.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: 36       # sustained pressure: a few dozen turns of guaranteed failure

spec_features.feature_name: finish(status, summary) lets model declare fixed/blocked
spec_features.evidence: tools.py: finish schema with enum [fixed, blocked]; ToolExecutor.execute sets self.finished=True, finish_status. agent.py:120-128: if executor.finished -> declared_done, and for non-fixed status ended_reason="gave_up" and break. The exit is dispatched AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Honored as a real loop termination; 'blocked' path ends run as gave_up.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: a ``finish`` tool the model can call to declare it is done or to give up
